spans.s:
f. (-रिक्)
The earth.
E.
भृ to nourish, इजि Uṇādi aff., and उर substituted for the radical vowel; also भूरिज्.

f. (-रिक्)
The earth.
E.
भृ to support, इजि Uṇādi aff., and ऋ changed to ऊर.

mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि)
Much, many.
ind.
Much, exceeding.
m. (-रिः)
1 A name of VIṢṆ

BRAHMĀ.
3
Ś

IVA.
4

A day.
n. (-रि)
Gold.
E.
भू to be, क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-मा-मा-म)
1 Splendid, bright.
2 Illustrious.
E.
भूरि, and धामन् splendor.

f. (-ष्पा)
Fennel: see शतपुष्पा.

m. (-मा)
The ruddy goose.

f. (-ना)
A plant, commonly Carmaghās.
E.
भूरि much, and फेन cuttle-fish bone.

m. (-यः)
A shakal.
E.
भूरि much, माय deceit.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Very profitable or beneficial.
n. (-भं)
Great gain.
E.
भूरि, and लाभ gain.

ind.
Manifold, many by many.
E.
भूरि many, शस् aff.

f. (-ण्डी)
A sort of sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.)
E.
भू the earth, रुह to grow; or रुद्ध to oppose, क aff., deriv. irr.

m. (-हः)
A tree.
E.
भू the earth, and रुह what grows.

m. (-र्ज्जः)
The Bhoj or Bhojpatra, a tree growing in the snowy mountains, a kind of birch; the bark is used for writing on, and very generally for Hooka snakes.
E.
भू the earth, and ऊर्ज्ज to be strong or hardy, aff. अच्.

m. (-कः)
A man of one of the inferior or mixed classes, sprung from an outcast Brahman by a woman of the same tribe.
E.
भूर्ज्ज the Bhoj, and कण्ठ the throat, कन् added.

m. (-त्रः)
The Bhojpatra: see भूर्ज्ज.
E.
भूर्ज्ज as above, पत्र a leaf.

f. (-र्णिः)
1 The earth.
2 A desart, a country ill supplied with water.
E.
भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. नि, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
The earth, the habitation of mortals.
E.
भूः the earth, and लोक the world.
